user.title: Xiaozhi MCP Configuration
user.description: Use two separate credentials: paste the complete Xiaozhi URL including ?token=... in the endpoint field, and a Home Assistant long-lived access token in the token field.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this integration instance
data_description.xiaozhi_endpoint: Paste the complete URL copied from Xiaozhi, including ?token=...; do not move its token to the field below.
data_description.access_token: Create this token in your Home Assistant profile under Security. This is NOT the Xiaozhi token.
data_description.mcp_server_url: URL of your Home Assistant MCP Server (default: http://localhost:8123/mcp_server/sse)
data_description.scan_interval: How often to check connection status (default: 30 seconds)
data_description.mcp_ca_cert: Optional absolute path to a trusted PEM CA certificate or self-signed server certificate, e.g. /config/certs/ha-ca.pem. Leave blank for default trust. Applies only to Home Assistant MCP; hostname verification remains enabled.

error.connection_failed: Failed to connect to Xiaozhi MCP endpoint
error.authentication_failed: Home Assistant rejected this token. Use a Home Assistant long-lived access token, not the token from the Xiaozhi URL.
error.invalid_endpoint: Use a valid TLS URL; plaintext is allowed only on loopback
error.xiaozhi_token_missing: Paste the complete Xiaozhi endpoint URL including ?token=... from your Xiaozhi dashboard.
error.xiaozhi_auth_failed: Xiaozhi rejected the endpoint credentials. Copy a fresh complete endpoint URL from Xiaozhi.
error.xiaozhi_connection_failed: Cannot connect to Xiaozhi. Check the complete endpoint URL, DNS and internet access.
error.xiaozhi_tls_failed: Cannot verify the Xiaozhi TLS certificate. Check the hostname, system clock and trusted certificate chain.
error.mcp_connection_failed: Cannot reach the Home Assistant MCP SSE server. Install/configure MCP Server and check this URL, DNS, port and HTTP/HTTPS scheme.
error.mcp_tls_failed: Cannot verify the Home Assistant MCP TLS certificate. Check its validity, trusted CA and matching hostname or IP address in Subject Alternative Name.
error.mcp_ca_invalid: Cannot load the MCP CA certificate. Use an absolute path to a readable PEM certificate file inside Home Assistant, not a private key.
error.mcp_wrong_transport: This bridge requires the Home Assistant MCP SSE URL ending in /mcp_server/sse. /api/mcp and /api/mcp_http are not supported by this bridge. Keep the native MCP Server enabled.
error.mcp_multiple_servers: Home Assistant reports multiple loaded MCP Server configurations. Keep one intended native MCP Server configuration enabled and disable only duplicate server configurations. Other AI clients are not automatically conflicts.
error.mcp_endpoint_unavailable: The MCP endpoint returned HTTP 404 or 405. Check the URL ending in /mcp_server/sse, enable/configure the native MCP Server, and check whether a proxy or another service handles that path.
error.mcp_invalid_response: The endpoint did not provide a valid MCP SSE handshake within five seconds. Check the URL ending in /mcp_server/sse and proxy routing; another service may be returning HTML, JSON or an incompatible stream.

mcp_wrong_transport.title: Check the MCP server for {name}
mcp_wrong_transport.description:
This bridge requires the Home Assistant MCP SSE URL ending in /mcp_server/sse. /api/mcp and /api/mcp_http are not supported by this bridge. Keep the native MCP Server enabled.

Open Settings > Devices & Services > Xiaozhi MCP > Configure to correct the MCP Server URL. After correcting the server or proxy configuration, reload this integration. This warning clears when the startup check succeeds.

mcp_multiple_servers.title: Check the MCP server for {name}
mcp_multiple_servers.description:
Home Assistant reports multiple loaded MCP Server configurations. Keep one intended native MCP Server configuration enabled and disable only duplicate server configurations. Other AI clients are not automatically conflicts.

Open Settings > Devices & Services > Xiaozhi MCP > Configure to correct the MCP Server URL. After correcting the server or proxy configuration, reload this integration. This warning clears when the startup check succeeds.
